jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Intern)
jobs.description: The Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer Intern, you work on the technical side of our customer relationships, before and after the deal. You help customers figure out which models, GPUs and configurations fit their needs, support our commercial team in technical sessions, and help customers when they run into issues with their workloads. Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Join Sport Alliance’s Data Products team and build ML solutions for Magicline and PerfectGym Next, used by thousands of fitness businesses and millions of members. You’ll work closely with engineers and product managers to take ML use cases from idea to production, with plenty of ownership and the opportunity to shape how we use ML and AI across our products. Your position in our team Build and deploy production-ready ML solutions, with a focus on classical ML and statistical methods. Own your models end-to-end — from data pipelines and modelling to deployment and monitoring. Improve the scalability and reliability of our existing ML data pipelines. Work closely with software engineers and product managers to turn business problems into practical solutions. Be the Data Science expert in a small Data Products team alongside two data engineers and one data analyst. Identify where ML and GenAI can solve real product and business problems, and choose the right approach. Work with our platform and LLM Ops teams when additional infrastructure support is needed. Help shape our ML and AI roadmap, identifying high-impact opportunities and influencing how ML capabilities evolve across our products. Your profile 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production. Strong knowledge of statistics and classical ML, with good judgment about which approach fits the problem, scale, and cost. Experience owning ML projects end-to-end, including data preparation, modelling, deployment, and monitoring. Strong hands-on Python skills (scikit-learn or similar frameworks) and SQL. You’re proactive and comfortable working on problems that aren’t fully defined yet. You communicate clearly and work well with both technical and non-technical colleagues. English at C1 level or above. Nice to have Experience with AWS, Terraform, or dbt. Experience working with LLMs or GenAI-based solutions. German language skills. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.description: About the Team The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole. You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog: GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production. What will you do? Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage. Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements. Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience. Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents. About you: 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems. Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem. Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery. Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider. Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems. Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering

jobs.title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. About the Role The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown. You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project. Key Responsibilities Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost. Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements , flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project. Develop system architectures and conceptual designs , perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces). Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans , and drive them through to completion with the teams involved. Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support. What we would love to see from you In this role, ideally, you will have the following: Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them. A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact. jobs.title: Avionics System Engineer - Navigation Sensors
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain. Key Responsibilities Navigation Sensor Systems Development Take technical ownership of the spacecraft's navigation sensor suite, including requirements definition, architecture, component selection, and system-level performance. Define and maintain sensor requirements, specifications, and interfaces in alignment with overall spacecraft mission and system requirements. Assess sensor technologies, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive technical decisions to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and suitability for the mission. Ensure proper integration of navigation sensors into the spacecraft avionics architecture. Supplier and Component Management Act as the technical focal point for navigation sensor suppliers throughout the component development lifecycle. Coordinate technical reviews, manage supplier deliverables, and resolve technical issues throughout development and procurement. Testing, Verification and Certification Develop and maintain verification and qualification strategies for navigation sensor components and systems. Define and review test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate and support component-level testing, environmental qualification, functional verification, and system integration testing. jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. About Atamis Atamis is a growing software business based in Cardiff. We make source-to-contract procurement software that is trusted across the NHS and the wider public sector, and used by private sector organisations too. We have a strong customer base, a product our customers rely on every working day, and a clear ambition: to move from software that records and reports on procurement to software that does the work. Every year the UK public sector spends hundreds of billions of pounds buying goods and services, and every pound is taxpayers’ money. Much of that buying is still slow and manual. Buying teams spend their week writing specifications, chasing quotes and justifying decisions, while suppliers, large and small, spend heavily on every bid. Atamis is on a mission to change how that work gets done. As we grow, our team is expanding so we can keep delivering high-quality solutions to our customers. About the role You’ll lead Product and Technology as one function and report to the CEO. The big question is how procurement should work if it were designed around AI from scratch: what AI should do, what a person must decide, and how a buyer can trust and defend the result. jobs.title: Staff Research Engineer
jobs.description: About the job Turn AI research ideas into experiments that help shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware. As a Staff Research Engineer in Graphcore Research, you’ll help shape complex projects from hypothesis to evaluation. You can join the team in Bristol, London or Cambridge. Our research spans efficient training and inference, numerics, reinforcement learning, and more. You’ll build implementations and algorithms that scale and explore how choices in model design and execution affect hardware efficiency. Your work will help to push AI models past the frontier, while turning the results of your work into recommendations that silicon and software engineers can use in their designs. You will explain to various groups which trade-offs matter as models grow and where bottlenecks emerge. You’ll also prepare papers and present findings at AI conferences and specialist workshops.  The team and culture Researchers across Bristol, London and Cambridge shape projects around shared research interests. You might work with colleagues to investigate how a model scales,  trace a distributed inference bottleneck, or develop an algorithm that enables training with more efficient number formats.  Research team bring a customer perspective and experience making models and software work on Graphcore’s stack at scale. Together, the teams develop ideas in efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference. Graphcore Research works with research groups around the world and publishes at venues including NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR. What we’re looking for A PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics or chemistry. Python skills with a framework such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience in model design, optimisation, evaluation and scaling. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Your Impact Engineering has changed, and we're changing with it. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one or more teams into AI-native software delivery, building products used by thousands of eCommerce merchants worldwide. We're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring for where it's going. You'll lead one or more engineering teams and help shape how they build software as AI reshapes the craft. You'll stay close to the work, coach your engineers, and help your teams move towards agentic workflows, with quality and security built in. We build on and around Shopify, which moves just as fast, so staying current is part of the job. You'll work from our Leicester city centre office three days a week, with two days remote, reporting to CTO. What you'll do Lead, coach and grow your engineers across one or more teams, building a culture of learning and technical excellence. Own your teams' delivery, working with Product, Design, QA and DevOps to ship high-quality work on time. Apply the architecture team's direction, and improve the scalability and performance of your teams' systems. Raise AI maturity across your team or teams against our maturity model, from prompt, context and harness practices towards agentic loops. Keep building with new tools yourself. Follow our AI development standards, including review of AI-generated code, and flag tooling gaps that slow the team down. Balance tech debt, reliability and feature delivery. Run incident response for your teams' systems and lead post-mortems. Take part in hiring, and support your engineers' performance and growth, including their AI fluency. What you'll bring 5+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years leading engineering teams. A degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience. jobs.title: Senior Linux / HPC Infrastructure Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: Szukamy doświadczonego inżyniera Linux/SRE do zespołu zajmującego się utrzymaniem i rozwojem infrastruktury HPC oraz klastrów GPU wykorzystywanych do AI. Pracujemy na fizycznych serwerach, z Linuxem, sieciami Data Center i technologiami NVIDIA. Dużo automatyzujemy, korzystamy z Ansible, Pythona, Basha i Gita. To nie jest typowa praca DevOps skupiona na chmurze i wdrażaniu aplikacji. Tutaj zdecydowanie więcej czasu spędza się na pracy z infrastrukturą, diagnozowaniu problemów i dbaniu o stabilność środowiska. Mile widziane Doświadczenie z HPC, klastrami obliczeniowymi lub infrastrukturą GPU. Znajomość technologii NVIDIA (Cumulus, DCGM, NCCL, NHC, NVIDIA Container Toolkit). Znajomość InfiniBand, RDMA, SLURM. Doświadczenie z Prometheus, Grafana, GitLab CI/CD. Doświadczenie z rozproszonymi i klastrowymi systemami plików (Lustre, Ceph). Kim jesteś (Soft Skills)? Potrafisz samodzielnie podejść do problemu i nie boisz się szukać rozwiązań. Lubisz współpracować z innymi i potrafisz jasno komunikować, co robisz. Bierzesz odpowiedzialność za swoją pracę i zmiany wprowadzane na produkcji. Chętnie automatyzujesz powtarzalne zadania. Nie masz problemu z pytaniem o pomoc ani dzieleniem się własną wiedzą. Deployment: Hands on experience building and deploying reinforcement learning agents. Deeply familiar with machine learning and reinforcement learning techniques. Hands on experience with MuJoCo, Pytorch, C++ Systems-minded and pragmatic about failure modes and imperfect inputs, disciplined about simulation and validation.

jobs.title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern. Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Die übrigen 40% arbeitest du eng mit der ärztlichen Leitung zusammen: Du vertrittst sie in Besprechungen und Entscheidungen, unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen und bist bei Abwesenheit die erste Ansprechperson für klinische Fragen. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Our goal: automate industrial tasks that are still done by hand today, such as assembly, machine tending, handling and inspection, by combining modern robot hardware with AI for perception, manipulation and task learning. You will have the opportunity to lead own topics and push the current boundaries. The role is like being part of a startup, but with the backing of an established research institute, connections to ETH Zurich and a strong network of Swiss industrial partners. This position sits at the interface between research and industry. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description: About Tebi Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland. About the Role We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets. You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team. This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly. What You’ll Do Build the acquisition engine Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot. Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity

Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. jobs.title: Meewerk Stage Marketing & Communicatie
jobs.description: Wij zoeken voor onze afdeling marketing en communicatie een enthousiaste en pro actieve stagiaire die zich gaat focussen op ondersteuning van campagnes en creëren van content. Lijkt je dit iets? Solliciteer dan nu! Let op: de stageperiode waarvoor wij zoeken is die van februari 2027 tot juni 2027 voor een periode van 15 tot 24 weken. Jouw rol Bij Heras bieden we je een leerzame en uitdagende stageplaats waarbij je volop kansen krijgt om waardevolle ervaringen op te doen die in het verdere verloop van je carrière nuttig zijn. Je gaat gecombineerd stage lopen op de afdeling Marketing en de afdeling Brand & Communications voor de Benelux. Je krijgt in ons mooie en dynamische bedrijf de kans om actief aan de slag te gaan met verschillende activiteiten en projecten. Uiteraard word je goed begeleid door de Marketing Manager en de Manager Brand & Commmunications. Vooraf zal je (stage)opdracht in overleg met jou en school worden opgesteld. Het onderwerp is mede afhankelijk van de projecten die lopen en jouw persoonlijke interesses. Bedenken, coördineren en schrijven van artikelen, blogs, nieuwsitems, customer cases Schrijven en inplannen van alle social media Ondersteunen interne communicatie en bijbehorende platformen Content management op diverse platformen, zoals onze websites Meedenken en meewerken aan marketingcampagnes, en daarvoor online content creëren Teksten schrijven voor e-mailcampagnes en nieuwsbrieven Ondersteuning van de marketing manager bij diverse projecten Bijdragen aan verschillende evenementen zoals bijvoorbeeld een stagemarkt Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Jouw profiel Je volgt momenteel een HBO- of MBO-studie Communicatie, Marketing of Journalistiek en zoekt een meewerkstage 2e, 3e of 4e jaars. jobs.title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
jobs.description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot ziekenhuizen en bedrijven. We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. De stageopdracht Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers? Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: • Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke mogelijkheden ze bieden. • Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien. • Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek. • Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen. • Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot eindproduct. • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerc

jobs.title: Praktikum Product Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Finanzberater verbringen einen großen Teil ihres Tages mit Papierkram, Excel-Listen und Programmen, die nicht miteinander reden. Wir bauen das System, das all das ersetzt. nyka Technologies ist ein kleines Team in den Wiesenwerken in Wuppertal. Wir betreiben die Plattform, mit der die Berater großer Finanzvertriebe jeden Tag arbeiten: ihr Betriebssystem Kunden, Verträge, Rechner und Beratung an einem Ort, von Anfang an für die Arbeit mit KI gebaut. Deine Aufgaben Als Product Engineer im Praktikum baust du daran mit. Was du baust, geht live und wird am nächsten Tag von echten Beratern benutzt. Du baust Features von der ersten Frage bis in die Produktion: verstehen, was der Berater wirklich braucht, umsetzen, testen, ausliefern. Du arbeitest mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code und lieferst trotzdem Code, für den du geradestehst. Du findest Fehler, bevor die Nutzer sie finden, und behebst sie an der Ursache. Du stellst Annahmen in Frage, auch unsere. Unser Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, aber du solltest es schnell lernen wollen. Dein Profil Uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie schnell du besser wirst. Ob du studierst, abgebrochen hast, eine Ausbildung gemacht oder dir alles selbst beigebracht hast, spielt keine Rolle. Denkvermögen. Du zerlegst ein unklares Problem in seine Teile, rechnest nach, statt zu schätzen, und merkst, wenn etwas nicht zusammenpasst. Engineering. Du hast schon Software gebaut, die läuft: eigene Projekte, Open Source, ein Nebenjob. Du schreibst Code, mit dem andere arbeiten können. Drive und Ownership. Du wartest nicht auf die nächste Anweisung. Wenn etwas kaputt ist, fühlst du dich zuständig, auch wenn es nicht deins ist. Lernfähigkeit. Du arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein. Von Versicherungen und Finanzen musst du nichts wissen, das bringen wir dir bei. Teamgeist. Du sagst, was du denkst, hörst zu und kannst dich irren, ohne es persönlich zu nehmen Deutsch fließend, denn unsere Nutzer sind deutsche

We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast ein Gespür für großartige digitale Produkte und willst mit KI etwas Neues schaffen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich tiefgreifend. Wir wollen Orientierung geben, alle verfügbaren Informationen verständlich zusammenführen und Menschen helfen, den bestmöglichen nächsten Schritt ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung zu finden . Über uns Wir sind Edtelligent, ein Tech-Unternehmen aus München mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden. Wir sind gebootstrappt und profitabel. Unser Gründerteam hat bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert. Wir haben bereits eine Software für den Weiterbildungsmarkt entwickelt, die von über 100 Bildungsanbietern genutzt wird , um ihre Kurse zu verwalten. jobs.description: What is the job? This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business. Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting. This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference. We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV. What will you be doing? Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them. Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines. Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters. Look after devices. jobs.description: What is the job? We’ve just moved into a new facility at Winnersh Triangle, bringing our offices, warehouse and secure storage together at a time when Montu is growing quickly. We’re looking for a Facilities & Estate Manager who can see what the site could become and make it happen. You’ll have the opportunity to make Winnersh a great place to work. That means listening to the people who use the building every day and making changes they’ll notice, whether that’s creating better spaces for teams to meet and work together or improving the layout so our pharmacy and warehouse teams can get medicines to patients efficiently. This is a senior, hands-on role with responsibility for the whole site. jobs.description: About the role Wall decor is one of the ways customers see what we make. They want the print to look the way it did on screen, and they want to hang it with pride. Our merged business is bringing its physical product range together, and wall decor needs one clear plan and one quality standard across our brands and markets. If you embrace curiosity and give our best to every product, this is your role. How you embrace curiosity daily Write and maintain the wall decor plan for our European markets. Own the wall decor quality standard, and agree it with Manufacturing. Read customer feedback, sales and competitor data, and turn it into clear insight. Decide which wall decor products belong in which markets, and manage their introduction and discontinuation. Brief the design team on new and existing occasions, and give Digital Product input on the creation journey. Track the measures that show whether the product is working for customers. How you make your mark Set a wall decor plan that moves a clear customer and business measure over the year. Raise the quality of the finished product, so fewer customers are disappointed when it arrives. Simplify the range, with fewer duplicate products across brands and markets. Deliver the projects behind the plan to agreed milestones. Give the Head of Physical Product a clear investment case for each wall decor priority. What you bring to the team 5 to 7 years of relevant experience owning a product plan or quality standard at category level. jobs.title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. Le stage constituera ainsi une premièr

jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. jobs.description: Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants) Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place! We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in France. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution. Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution. Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz. Team At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 90+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role Voodoo is looking for a Creative Strategist to work with a squad of creative operators. You will own creative production for BeReal and play a central role in helping Voodoo turn great mobile products into global hits Prioritize and drive creative production for BeReal based on product and user acquisition strategy Lead up to 2/3 people: recruit, coach, and increase talent density Analyze your team’s performance, define action plans, and hit your KPIs Discover new creative concepts, and share best practices with other creative teams Lead key projects to test new tools, improve processes, etc. Source and discover top-performing content across social media platforms Experiment with viral marketing tactics, testing unconventional approaches to maximize organic and paid reach and engagement. Assist with video production and editing when necessary. Profile You have 2+ years of experience in performance marketing in the mobile apps industry You’ve successfully led high-impact projects You speak and write English fluently, French is a plus You wish to work in an environment that values candor, freedom, ownership and responsibility Benefits Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Media Foundations - BeReal
jobs.description: About BeReal At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role We are looking for a Senior iOS Camera & Video Engineer to join BeReal and work on one of the most critical parts of our product: the camera experience. You will build and improve the capture, image, and video pipelines behind BeReal's core flows, including multi-camera capture, instant capture, front/back video composition, and media quality. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working close to Apple's media APIs, solving real-time performance challenges, and delivering a fast, reliable, high-quality experience. What you will do: Design, build, and maintain high-performance camera and video features on iOS. Own and improve parts of our AVFoundation camera stack: capture sessions, devices, formats, frame rates, exposure, and device capabilities. Build and optimize real-time image and video processing pipelines. Improve capture quality, latency, stability, and smoothness across supported iPhone models. Work on multi-camera flows, front/back video composition, video encoding, media export, and audio/video synchronization. Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, battery usage, thermal behaviour, buffer allocation, and multithreaded processing. Investigate device-specific and iOS-version-specific behaviour, and propose pragmatic technical trade-offs. Work closely with iOS engineers, product, design, backend, and data teams. Contribute directly to the codebase and raise engineering standards around media performance and reliability. Profile 6+ years of iOS experience, including strong hands-on work on camera, video, or media-heavy features. Deep expertise with AVFoundation and iOS camera APIs: AVC

jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres. Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta. Le défi Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes : La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils. Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence. L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories. Tes missions Ads et acquisition payante Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois. Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA. Tester chaque semaine de nouvelles créas et audiences, couper ce qui ne marche pas, scaler ce qui marche. Affiner le ciblage sur les profils qui achètent vraiment, à partir des retours de l'équipe sales et des données CRM. jobs.title: Senior Director, Legal Innovation
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role As Senior Director, Legal Innovation, you'll be a senior voice for Legora in the corporate and in-house legal community — representing the company in the field, advising legal departments on how to adopt AI well, and helping shape where the business of in-house legal is going. The role pairs public thought leadership (panels, forums, published analysis) with substantive project work, including building practical ROI frameworks for in-house legal teams alongside our Value Engineering function. jobs.title: Unity Software Engineer
jobs.description: Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people, vehicles and robots using 3D LiDAR data. Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction. Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore, Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain. You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do: Insights about Outsight . Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across 4 continents. Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers. Context Are you passionate about building immersive 3D experiences and pushing the limits of what’s possible with Unity? We’re looking for a Unity Software Engineer to help us shape the future of LiDAR simulation . In this role, you’ll design, develop, and refine features within our Unity-based platform, working hand-in-hand with designers, 3D artists, and engineers . Your work will drive the creation of scalable, high-performance, and intuitive solutions that empower our users and bring complex technology to life. Responsibilites Contribute to the functional and technical evolutions of the simulator. Synchronize with different teams including R&D, 3D artists and engineers. Prioritize and schedule the releases of bug fixes and features. Optimize the performance of our simulator with the help of Unity’s profiler tools. Design and restructure the code base. Develop dynamic simulation tools for model training and live demos. Continue the development of a realistic crowd simulation to navigate 3D environments. Requirements for the Role Education : Bache
